text: On the authority of Juwayriyah, may God be pleased with her, that the Messenger of God, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, left her early morning when he prayed the morning prayer, while she was in her mosque, then he returned after the sacrifice of the morning prayer, while she was sitting, and said: Are you still in the state in which I left you? She said: Yes, the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: I have said four words after you, three times. If they were weighed against what you have said since today, they would be equal: Glory be to God and praise be to Him, the number of His creation, the satisfaction of Himself, the weight of His Throne, and the ink of His words.
